site.label: Speed and weight
site.juki: 1,500 spm, slider from 200 spm. 25.4 lb (11.5 kg).

facts.value: max 6 mm (0.2 in)

facts.note: Juki page confirms 130/705H. The manual lists 'HAx1 or HLx5 #11, #14' (p.11), which reads as the supplied sizes, not the usable range.

site.label: Needle
site.others: Dealer copy says HA type needles supplied, 130/705H not stated.

facts.value: Hand lever 7 mm or 9 mm; knee lifter 12 mm
facts.source: juki-manual p.11; juki-page says 'Manual' and 'as high as 12mm' by knee lifter
facts.note: Spec records 12 mm by knee lifter; the hand-lever 7/9 mm figures are new.

facts.value: Trim button and foot controller heel both trim needle and bobbin thread
Feed dogs raised and lowered by a switch (drop feed)
Aluminum die-casting
Manual: 45.2 W x 35.0 H x 21.9 L cm = 17.8 x 13.8 x 8.6 in
Juki page: 17.75 W x 9 H x 8.5 D in
facts.note: Height 9 in vs 13.8 in in the manual. The web page figure looks like a transcription error; prefer the manual.

site.label: Height
site.juki: Manual: 35.0 cm tall (13.8 in). Juki's web page: 9 in.
site.others: One dealer repeats 9 in. Juki's own manual contradicts the web page.

facts.value: Bed 43 W x 17.8 L cm (16.9 x 7.0 in); auxiliary table 59 x 27.7 cm (23.2 x 10.9 in)
Auxiliary table 23 x 13 in (590 x 335 mm)
facts.note: Depth 13 in (335 mm) vs 10.9 in (277 mm) in the manual; a Kathy Quilts dealer post also says 590 x 277 mm. Juki's 'work area up to 23 inches' claim uses the width.

facts.value: Not stated as a needle-to-arm figure in the Juki page or the manual
facts.note: The 8.5 in throat comes from dealers ('8.5 x 6'). Juki's own depth figure is 8.6 in (21.9 cm) and the page lists 8.5 D, so the dealer throat number may be the machine depth. Not verified; keep [verify] per rules 9 and 11.

site.label: Throat space
site.juki: No needle-to-arm figure published. Machine depth is 8.6 in.
site.others: Dealers quote 8.5 x 6 in. Four sources say about 9 in.

facts.value: Standard per manual p.12: zipper attaching foot, upper feed (even feed) presser foot, 1/4 in quilting foot. Also standard: foot controller, auxiliary table, 2 screwdrivers, brush, 4 bobbins, oiler, needles (HAx1), spool cap, cover, power cord, knee lifter.
facts.note: The 1/5 in quilting foot appears only under Optional accessories on the Juki page, and the manual marks the 1/5 in foot 'Option'. The Juki feature bullet 'Juki 1/4 Inch and 1/5 Inch Quilting Feet' is ambiguous marketing. Dealer and forum claims that both ship are not supported by Juki's lists.

site.label: Feet in the box
site.juki: Standard: zipper foot, even feed foot, 1/4 in quilting foot. The 1/5 in quilting foot is optional.
site.others: Four review pages and several dealers say both quilting feet ship.

facts.value: Standard list on the page: standard presser foot, zipper attaching foot, 1/4 quilting foot, even feed foot, auxiliary table; the even feed foot also appears under Optional
facts.note: The manual's 15 item list does not include a separate standard presser foot.

facts.value: Oil with New Defrix Oil No.1 (oiler supplied); lubricate once a day if used every day; test sew after
facts.note: Backs the owner theme that the machine needs regular oiling.

site.label: Oiling
site.juki: Oil at each marked point once a day if used every day, then test sew.
site.others: Owners describe oiling as a habit to learn.

facts.value: Automatic needle threader, needle up/down button, adjustable presser foot pressure, high shank, L-style bobbin, LED light
USD 2,169.00 suggested retail
facts.note: Matches the 'regular price' on Sewing Machines Plus. Dealer sale price seen 1,239 (2026-09-30). The earlier briefing's 2,099 regular price is older.

facts.value: Not stated on the Juki page or in the manual (manual says to keep it with the warranty card)

site.others: Dealers publish 5 years limited on parts and 2 years on electrical parts.
